active).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        all: bool,\n\n        /// Session name pattern to match (partial match).\n        #[arg(short = 'i', long)]\n        identifier: Option<String>,\n    },\n\n    /// List active workers.\n    List {\n        /// Output format.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n        format: ListFormat,\n    },\n\n    /// Attach to a worker's tmux session.\n    Attach {\n        /// Worker identifier (e.g., alpha, bravo) or partial session name.\n        identifier: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Show fleet status, bead counts, and cost summary.\n    Status {\n        /// Output format.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n        format: ListFormat,\n\n        /// Show per-worker breakdown.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        by_worker: bool,\n\n        /// Show cost summary with per-worker and per-workspace breakdowns.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        cost: bool,\n\n        /// Filter events since this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        since: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Filter events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        until: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Show cooldown state for idle-time strands (reflect, weave, pulse, unravel).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        idle_strands: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// View and query telemetry logs.\n    Logs {\n        /// Stream events in real-time (tail -f equivalent).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        follow: bool,\n\n        /// Filter expression(s). Supports:\n        ///   field=value    — exact match (e.g., event_type=bead.claim.succeeded)\n        ///   field~pattern  — regex match (e.g., event_type~bead\\..*)\n        ///   field>number   — numeric greater-than (e.g., duration_ms>500)\n        ///   glob           — glob on event_type (e.g., bead.claim.*)\n        /// Multiple --filter flags are ANDed together.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        filter: Vec<String>,\n\n        /// Show events since this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        since: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Show events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        until: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Output format.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n        format: LogFormat,\n    },\n\n    /// View or inspect configuration.\n    #[command(name = \"config\")]\n    ConfigCmd {\n        /// Get a specific config key.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        get: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Dump all resolved config values.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        dump: bool,\n\n        /// Show source annotations (requires --dump).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        show_source: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Check system health and repair.\n    Doctor {\n        /// Attempt automatic repair of issues found.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        repair: bool,\n\n        /// Workspace to check (defaults to config workspace).\n        #[arg(short = 'w', long)]\n        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    },\n\n    /// Show version information.\n    Version,\n\n    /// Validate an agent adapter.\n    TestAgent {\n        /// Name of the adapter to test.\n        name: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Run canary tests against a :testing binary.\n    Canary {\n        /// Show channel status instead of running tests.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        status: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Check for and install updates from GitHub releases.\n    Upgrade {\n        /// Check only — show available update without installing.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        check: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Rollback to the previous :stable binary.\n    Rollback,\n\n    /// Run learning consolidation on demand.\n    ///\n    /// Reads bead close bodies since the last consolidation, extracts\n    /// retrospective patterns, merges them into learnings.md, and promotes\n    /// high-frequency learnings to skill files.\n    Reflect {\n        /// Workspace to consolidate (defaults to config workspace).\n        #[arg(short = 'w', long)]\n        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n\n        /// Skip cooldown and minimum bead threshold checks.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        force: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Fetch the latest gitleaks rules and update the vendored config.\n    ///\n    /// Downloads gitleaks.toml from the upstream GitHub repository, validates\n    /// it by compiling all rules, and writes it to the output path.\n    /// Rebuild needle after running this command to embed the new rules.\n    #[command(name = \"update-rules\")]\n    UpdateRules {\n        /// Destination path for the downloaded config (default: config/gitleaks.toml).\n        #[arg(short = 'o', long)]\n        output: Option<PathBuf>,\n    },\n\n    /// Show outcome statistics aggregated from telemetry logs.\n    ///\n    /// Reads JSONL telemetry files, correlates dispatch/outcome/effort events\n    /// by bead ID, and prints per-group statistics.\n    ///\n    /// Examples:\n    ///   needle stats --by template_version --since 7d\n    ///   needle stats --by task_type --since 30d\n    ///   needle stats --by worker --since 7d --format json\n    Stats {\n        /// Dimension to group results by.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum)]\n        by: StatsBy,\n\n        /// Include only events since this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        since: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Include only events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        until: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Output format.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n        format: ListFormat,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Output format for the list command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum ListFormat {\n    Table,\n    Json,\n}\n\n/// Output format for the logs command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum LogFormat {\n    /// Human-readable table format (default).\n    Table,\n    /// JSON Lines format (one JSON object per line).\n    Json,\n    /// Alias for table (human-readable).\n    Human,\n    /// Alias for json (JSON Lines).\n    Jsonl,\n}\n\n/// Grouping dimension for the `needle stats` command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum StatsBy {\n    /// Group by template version tag (e.g., `\"pluck-v2\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"template_version\")]\n    TemplateVersion,\n    /// Group by template name / task type (e.g., `\"pluck\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"task_type\")]\n    TaskType,\n    /// Group by worker identifier (e.g., `\"needle-alpha\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"worker\")]\n    Worker,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Entry point\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Entry point called from `main`.\npub fn run() -> Result<()> {\n    let cli = Cli::parse();\n\n    match cli.command {\n        CliCommand::Run {\n            workspace,\n            agent,\n            count,\n            identifier,\n            timeout,\n            resume,\n            hot_reload,\n        } => cmd_run(\n            workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, resume, hot_reload,\n        ),\n        CliCommand::Stop { all, identifier } => cmd_stop(all, identifier),\n        CliCommand::Cleanup { all, identifier } => cmd_cleanup(all, identifier),\n        CliCommand::List { format } => cmd_list(format),\n        CliCommand::Attach { identifier } => cmd_attach(&identifier),\n        CliCommand::Status {\n            format,\n            by_worker,\n            cost,\n            since,\n            until,\n            idle_strands,\n        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n        CliCommand::Logs {\n            follow,\n            filter,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n            get,\n            dump,\n            show_source,\n        } => cmd_config(get, dump, show_source),\n        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n        CliCommand::Version => {\n            cmd_version();\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } => cmd_reflect(workspace, force),\n        CliCommand::UpdateRules { output } => cmd_update_rules(output),\n        CliCommand::Stats {\n            by,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Command handlers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n///\n/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\nfn cmd_run(\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    resume: bool,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n        max_workers: None,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        config.agent.timeout = t;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n    }\n\n    if resume {\n        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n\n        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n\n        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n        )\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n        match &resume_state {\n            Some(state) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n                    session = %state.session,\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n                );\n            }\n            None => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n            });\n        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n            new_hash: current_hash,\n        })?;\n\n        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n    }\n\n    if is_needle_inner() {\n        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n    } else {\n        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n        launch_workers(\n            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\nfn launch_workers(\n    config: Config,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let agent_name = agent\n        .as_deref()\n        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n        .to_string();\n    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n\n    if count == 0 {\n        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n    }\n    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n        bail!(\n            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n            count,\n            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            requested = count,\n            capped_to = max_workers,\n            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n        );\n        eprintln!(\n            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n        );\n        max_workers\n    } else {\n        count\n    };\n\n    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n    }\n\n    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n        tracing::info!(\n            occupied = ?occupied,\n            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        if occupied.contains(id) {\n            bail!(\n                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n                id,\n                agent_name,\n                id\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n            NATO_ALPHABET\n                .iter()\n                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n        })]\n    } else {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %name,\n                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                effective_count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        ids\n    };\n\n    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker_id,\n            sequence = seq,\n            total = effective_count,\n            session = %session_name,\n            \"launching worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n        }\n\n        launch_in_tmux(\n            &session_name,\n            workspace.clone(),\n            agent.clone(),\n            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n            timeout,\n            hot_reload,\n        )?;\n\n        println!(\n            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n            seq + 1,\n            effective_count,\n            worker_id\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n    if effective_count > 1 {\n        println!(\n            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n        );\n        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n    } else {\n        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n///\n/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n///\n/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    worker_id: String,\n    session_id: String,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n            .with(fmt_layer)\n            .try_init()\n            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the stdout layer when OTLP is disabled\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n                .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n                .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => println!(\"No needle sessions running.\"),\n            ListFormat::Json => println!(\"[]\"),\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", \"SESSION\", \"CREATED\", \"STATUS\");\n            println!(\"{}\", \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions)\n                .context(\"failed to serialize sessions to JSON\")?;\n            println!(\"{json}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle version` — print version info.\nfn cmd_version() {\n    let version = env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\");\n    let os = std::env::consts::OS;\n    let arch = ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// attach, status, config, doctor\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle attach <identifier>` — attach to a running worker's tmux session.\nfn cmd_attach(identifier: &str) ->   idle_strands: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let registry = stats` — show outcome statistics from telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_stats(\n    by: StatsBy,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: ListFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::stats::{compute_stats, StatsDimension};\n\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let log_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\");\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(&log_dir, since_dt, until_dt, None)?;\n\n    let dimension = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => StatsDimension::TemplateVersion,\n        StatsBy::TaskType => StatsDimension::TaskType,\n        StatsBy::Worker => StatsDimension::Worker,\n    };\n\n    let mut rows = compute_stats(&events, dimension);\n    // Sort by beads descending so most active groups appear first.\n    rows.sort_by(|a, b| b.beads.cmp(&a.beads).then(a.key.cmp(&b.key)));\n\n    let dim_label = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => \"TEMPLATE VERSION\",\n        StatsBy::TaskType => \"TASK TYPE\",\n        StatsBy::Worker => \"WORKER\",\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            if rows.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No telemetry data found.\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            let key_width = rows.iter().map(|r| r.key.len()).max().unwrap_or(16).max(16);\n            println!(\n                \"{:<width$} {:>6} {:>6} {:>6} {:>8} {:>9} {:>10} {:>12}\",\n                dim_label,\n                \"BEADS\",\n                \"PASS\",\n                \"FAIL\",\n                \"TIMEOUT\",\n                \"PASS RATE\",\n                \"AVG TOK\",\n                \"AVG COST\",\n                width = key_width,\n            );\n            println!(\n                \"{}\",\n                \"-\".repeat(key_width + 6 + ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\nenum CheckStatus {\n    Pass,\n    Warn,\n    Fail,\n}\n\nstruct CheckResult {\n    name: String,\n    status: CheckStatus,\n    message: String,\n    /// Extra lines printed indented below the main line.\n    detail: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl CheckResult {\n    fn pass(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Pass,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn warn(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Warn,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn fail(name: impl Into<String>, msg: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        CheckResult {\n            name: name.into(),\n            status: CheckStatus::Fail,\n            message: msg.into(),\n            detail: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n    fn with_detail(mut self, lines: Vec<String>) -> Self {\n        self.detail = lines;\n        self\n    }\n    fn display(&self) -> String {\n        let label = match self.status {\n            CheckStatus::Pass => \"PASS\",\n            CheckStatus::Warn => \"WARN\",\n            CheckStatus::Fail => \"FAIL\",\n        };\n        format!(\"[{label}]  {:<28}  {}\", self.name, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// format!(\"{total} total, none stale\")\n            },\n        );\n    }\n    if repair {\n        let mut removed = 0usize;\n        let mut failed_names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        for p in   ///\n1879\t    /// defaults → global file → workspace `.needle.yaml` → env vars → CLI args\n1880\t    ///\n1881\t    /// Returns the resolved config and a source map showing where each value\n1882\t    /// came from. The source map only contains entries for values that were\n1883\t    /// overridden from their defaults.\n1884\t    pub fn load_resolved(workspace_root: &Path, cli: CliOverrides) -> Result<(Config, SourceMap)> {\n1885\t        let mut sources = SourceMap::new();\n1886\t\n1887\t        // Layer 1 + 2: defaults + global config.\n1888\t        let global_path = existed).\n1892\t        if global_path.exists() {\n1893\t            let source = ConfigSource::GlobalFile(global_path);\n1894\t            // Mark all top-level sections as from global.\n1895\t            for key in &[\n1896\t                \"agent.default\",\n1897\t                \"agent.timeout\",\n1898\t                \"worker.max_workers\",\n1899\t Self::load_workspace(workspace_root)? {\n1909\t            Self::apply_workspace(&mut config, &ws_overrides, workspace_root, &mut sources);\n1910\t        }\n1911\t\n1912\t        // Layer 4: \"SelfModificationConfig::default_canary_workspace\")]\n    pub canary_workspace: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Automatically promote :testing to :stable when canary passes.\n    /// When false, requires manual `needle promote` command.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub auto_promote: bool,\n\n    /// Maximum time (seconds) to run canary tests before considering it a timeout.\n    #[serde(default = \"SelfModificationConfig::default_canary_timeout\")]\n    pub canary_timeout: u64,\n\n    /// Fleet hot-reloads from :stable between beads (default: true).\n    /// When enabled, workers check for a new :stable binary after each bead\n    /// cycle and re-exec if a different binary is detected.\n    #[serde(default = \"SelfModificationConfig::default_hot_reload\")]\n    pub hot_reload: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SelfModificationConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        SelfModificationConfig {\n            enabled: false,\n            canary_workspace: Self::default_canary_workspace(),\n            auto_promote: false,\n            canary_timeout: Self::default_canary_timeout(),\n            hot_reload: Self::default_hot_reload(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SelfModificationConfig {\n    fn default_canary_workspace() -> PathBuf {\n        dirs_or_home(\".needle/canary\")\n    }\n\n    fn default_canary_timeout() -> u64 {\n        300 // 5 minutes\n    }\n\n    fn default_hot_reload() -> bool {\n        true\n    }\n}\n\n/// FABRIC telemetry forwarding configuration.\n///\n/// When enabled, NEEDLE workers POST structured events to the FABRIC\n/// web server (`fabric web`) for live dashboard display.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct FabricConfig {\n    /// Whether to forward events to FABRIC (default: false).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub enabled: bool,\n\n    /// HTTP endpoint to POST events to (e.g., `http://localhost:3000/api/events`).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub endpoint: String,\n\n    /// Request timeout in seconds (default: 2).\n    #[serde(default = \"FabricConfig::default_timeout\")]\n    pub timeout: u64,\n\n    /// Batch events before sending instead of sending one at a time (default: false).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub batching: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for FabricConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        FabricConfig {\n            enabled: false,\n            endpoint: String::new(),\n            timeout: Self::default_timeout(),\n            batching: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FabricConfig {\n    fn default_timeout() -> u64 {\n        2\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config Source Tracking\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Subset of configuration that can be overridden per-workspace via `.needle.yaml`.\n///\n/// Only these sections are allowed at the workspace level:\n/// - `agent.default`, `agent.timeout`\n/// - `strands` (weave, pulse, unravel)\n/// - `prompt.*`\n/// - `verification` (legacy) or `gates` (new pluggable system)\n///\n/// Non-overridable sections (worker, limits, health, telemetry) are detected\n/// and produce warnings.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: Option<WorkspaceAgentOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: Option<WorkspaceStrandsOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: Option<PromptConfig>,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Option<Vec<String>>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Option<Vec<GateConfig>>,\n    /// Workspace identity labels (overridable per-workspace).\n    ///\n    /// Set in `.needle.yaml` under `workspace.labels`. Used for cross-workspace\n    /// skill sharing: skills from Explore workspaces whose labels overlap with\n    /// these labels are injected into prompts alongside local skills.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: Option<WorkspaceLabelsOverride>,\n}\n\n/// Agent fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceAgentOverrides {\n    pub default: Option<String>,\n    pub timeout: Option<u64>,\n}\n\n/// Strand fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceStrandsOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub weave: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub pulse: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub unravel: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n}\n\n/// Non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config.\n///\n/// Note: `workspace` is intentionally absent — `workspace.labels` IS overridable\n/// per-workspace. The path fields (`default`, `home`) are simply ignored if set.\nconst NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS: &[&str] = &[\"worker\", \"limits\", \"health\", \"telemetry\"];\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: AgentConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub worker: WorkerConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: WorkspaceConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: StrandsConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency and rate limits.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub limits: LimitsConfig,\n    /// Per-model token pricing (USD per million tokens).\n    #[serde(default = \"crate::cost::default_pricing\")]\n    pub pricing: PricingConfig,\n    /// Daily budget thresholds for cost enforcement.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub budget: BudgetConfig,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC live dashboard forwarding.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub fabric: FabricConfig,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// CLI-level overrides applied after all file-based config loading.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct CliOverrides {\n    pub workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    pub worker_name: Option<String>,\n    pub agent_binary: Option<String>,\n    pub max_workers: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config from `~/.config/needle/config.yaml`.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config (not an error).\n    pub fn load_global() -> Result<Config> {\n        let path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        Self::load_from_path(&path)\n    }\n\n    /// Load config from a specific path.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config.\n    pub fn load_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Config> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(Config::default());\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let config: Config = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load workspace overrides from `.needle.yaml` in the given workspace root.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if the file does not exist. Emits warnings for\n    /// non-overridable keys found in the workspace config.\n    pub fn load_workspace(workspace_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<WorkspaceOverrides>> {\n        let path = workspace_root.join(\".needle.yaml\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        // Check for non-overridable keys and warn.\n        Self::warn_non_overridable_keys(&text, &path)?;\n\n        let overrides: WorkspaceOverrides = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(Some(overrides))\n    }\n\n    /// Warn about non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config YAML.\n    fn warn_non_overridable_keys(yaml_text: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let value: serde_yaml::Value = serde_yaml::from_str(yaml_text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        if let serde_yaml::Value::Mapping(map) = value {\n            for key in map.keys() {\n                if let serde_yaml::Value::String(key_str) = key {\n                    if NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS.contains(&key_str.as_str()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            key = %key_str,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"workspace config contains non-overridable setting '{}' — ignored\",\n                            key_str,\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Apply workspace overrides to a config.\n    ///\n    /// Only overridable fields are applied. Records sources in the source map.\n    pub fn apply_workspace(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: &WorkspaceOverrides,\n        ws_path: &Path,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        let source = ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(ws_path.join(\".needle.yaml\"));\n\n        if let Some(ref agent) = overrides.agent {\n            if let Some(ref default) = agent.default {\n                config.agent.default = default.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(timeout) = agent.timeout {\n                config.agent.timeout = timeout;\n                sources.insert(\"agent.timeout\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref strands) = overrides.strands {\n            if strands.weave.is_some() {\n                sources.insert(\"strands.weave\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if strands.pulse.is_some() {\n                sources.insert(\"strands.pulse\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if strands.unravel.is_some() {\n                sources.insert(\"strands.unravel\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref prompt) = overrides.prompt {\n            config.prompt = prompt.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.context_files\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.instructions\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref verification) = overrides.verification {\n            config.verification = verification.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"verification\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref gates) = overrides.gates {\n            config.gates = gates.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"gates\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            if !ws.labels.is_empty() {\n                config.workspace.labels = ws.labels.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"workspace.labels\".to_string(), source);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply environment variable overrides (`NEEDLE_*` prefix, `__` separator).\n    ///\n    /// Example: `NEEDLE_AGENT__DEFAULT=opus` sets `agent.default` to `\"opus\"`.\n    pub fn apply_env_overrides(config: &mut Config, sources: &mut SourceMap) {\n        for (key, value) in std::env::vars() {\n            if let Some(suffix) = key.strip_prefix(\"NEEDLE_\") {\n                let config_path = suffix.to_lowercase().replace(\"__\", \".\");\n                let source = ConfigSource::EnvVar(key.clone());\n\n                match config_path.as_str() {\n                    \"agent.default\" => {\n                        config.agent.default = value;\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"agent.timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.agent.timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for agent.timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.max_workers\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u32>() {\n                            config.worker.max_workers = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.max_workers — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.idle_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.idle_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.idle_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.launch_stagger_seconds — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_interval_secs — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_ttl_secs — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.enabled\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<bool>() {\n                            config.self_modification.enabled = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.enabled — expected true/false\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.auto_promote\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<bool>() {\n                            config.self_modification.auto_promote = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.auto_promote — expected true/false\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.canary_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.self_modification.canary_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.canary_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        tracing::debug!(\n                            env_var = %key,\n                            config_path = %config_path,\n                            \"unrecognized NEEDLE_ environment variable — ignored\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides (highest precedence) to a loaded config.\n    pub fn apply_overrides(config: &mut Config, overrides: CliOverrides) {\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(config, overrides, &mut SourceMap::new());\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides with source tracking.\n    pub fn apply_cli_overrides(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: CliOverrides,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        if let Some(ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            config.workspace.default = ws;\n            sources.insert(\"workspace.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(agent) = overrides.agent_binary {\n            config.agent.default = agent;\n            sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(n) = overrides.max_workers {\n            config.worker.max_workers = n;\n            sources.insert(\"worker.max_workers\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        // worker_name is handled at the Worker level, not stored in Config\n    }\n\n    /// Load the fully resolved configuration using the complete hierarchy:\n    ///\n    /// defaults → global file → workspace `.needle.yaml` → env vars → CLI args\n    ///\n    /// Returns the resolved config and a source map showing where each value\n    /// came from. The source map only contains entries for values that were\n    /// overridden from their defaults.\n    pub fn load_resolved(workspace_root: &Path, cli: CliOverrides) -> Result<(Config, SourceMap)> {\n        let mut sources = SourceMap::new();\n\n        // Layer 1 + 2: defaults + global config.\n        let global_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        let mut config = Self::load_from_path(&global_path)?;\n\n        // Track which fields came from global config (if file existed).\n        if global_path.exists() {\n            let source = ConfigSource::GlobalFile(global_path);\n            // Mark all top-level sections as from global.\n            for key in &[\n                \"agent.default\",\n                \"agent.timeout\",\n                \"worker.max_workers\",\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n            ] {\n                sources.insert((*key).to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Layer 3: workspace config.\n        if let Some(ws_overrides) = Self::load_workspace(workspace_root)? {\n            Self::apply_workspace(&mut config, &ws_overrides, workspace_root, &mut sources);\n        }\n\n        // Layer 4: environment variables.\n        Self::apply_env_overrides(&mut config, &mut sources);\n\n        // Layer 5: CLI arguments.\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(&mut config, cli, &mut sources);\n\n        Ok((config, sources))\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a resolved config.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of errors (empty = valid).\n    pub fn validate(config: &Config) -> Vec<ConfigError> {\n        let mut errors = Vec::new();\n\n        if config.agent.default.is_empty() {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"agent.default\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must not be empty\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers == 0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be at least 1\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers > 50 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"{} exceeds practical fleet limit of 50\",\n                    config.worker.max_workers\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.cpu_load_warn <= 0.0 || config.worker.cpu_load_warn > 1.0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.cpu_load_warn\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be in range (0.0, 1.0]\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs < 3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"should be >= 3 * heartbeat_interval_secs ({}); detection may be unreliable\",\n                    3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        errors\n    }\n\n    /// Format config values with source annotations for `--dump --show-source`.\n    pub fn dump_with_sources(config: &Config, sources: &SourceMap) -> Vec<String> {\n        let fields: Vec<(&str, String)> = vec![\n            (\"agent.default\", config.agent.default.clone()),\n            (\"agent.timeout\", config.agent.timeout.to_string()),\n            (\"worker.max_workers\", config.worker.max_workers.to_string()),\n            (\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                config.worker.idle_timeout.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\",\n                config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.context_files\",\n                format!(\"{:?}\", config.prompt.context_files),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.instructions\",\n                config\n                    .prompt\n                    .instructions\n                    .as_deref()\n                    .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                    .to_string(),\n            ),\n        ];\n\n        fields\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(key, value)| {\n                let source = sources.get(key).cloned().unwrap_or(ConfigSource::Default);\n                format!(\"{}: {} (from: {})\", key, value, source)\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Resolve a path relative to the user's home directory.\nfn dirs_or_home(relative: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n        PathBuf::from(home).join(relative)\n    } else {\n        PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\").join(relative)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn default_config_is_valid() {\n        let config = Config::default();\n        let errors = ConfigLoader::validate(&config);\n        assert!(\n            errors.is_empty(),\n            \"default config has validation errors: {:?}\",\n            errors\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn missing_agent_binary_fails_validation() {\n        let mut config = Config::default();\n        config.agent.default = String::new();\n        let errors = ConfigLoader::validate(&config);\n        assert!(\n            errors.iter().any(|e| e.field == \"agent.default\"),\n            \"expected agent.default error, got: {:?}\",\n            errors\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn zero_max_workers_fails_validation() {\n        let mut config = Config::default();\n        config.worker.max_workers = 0;\n        let errors =
